scope: Test harness and regression coverage only; approved localhost:55432 database, runner-owned disposable schemas and pinned Bun 1.3.6. No production implementation changes.

diagnosis.confirmedDeadlock: The original PostgreSQL 40P01 cycle was fixture teardown DELETE Workspace cascading into ClipExport versus a still-running UPDATE ClipExport after Bun reported the five-second test timeout. It was not evidence of two production admission transactions taking opposite locks.
diagnosis.originalJsonCause: Unproven. The original JSON Task replay error was not captured as a typed code. An unchanged full baseline and five fresh-schema focused repeats passed all Worker cases. The new assertion reports only numeric RPC code and typed data.error before reading result.taskId.

baselineFull.limit: Worker cases passed; epoch cascade halted the runner before later fence suites.

changes: Snapshot fixture identities and active owned DatabaseScopes, release controlled barriers, and await those scopes before destructive teardown. A later test cannot be included by a delayed cleanup snapshot.

Make exact existing failed dispatches eligible in disposable Worker fixtures after checking their persisted failure, unacknowledged state and released delivery token. Remove wall-clock retry sleeps from registration tests; do not alter production retry configuration or domain rows.
Bind upload/render readiness selection to exact kind, epoch, generation and base obligation instead of an unordered broad subject selection.
Keep actual HTTP/SDK JSON/SSE calls, receipt assertions and delayed-confirmation barriers, with the original five-second test timeout.

Cover actual default production backoff once at the dispatch boundary: early replay remains not_due without another scheduler call or ledger change, then elapsed PostgreSQL due time admits the same dispatch without a new domain attempt.

cleanup.observed: Cleanup finished while an owned request was still paused, and the eventual Workspace update could not complete.

backoffMutation.observed: Temporarily disabling only the local due predicate made the early-refusal regression fail. The exact production file was restored before every green gate and is absent from the patch.

firstCombinedFull.limit: Final code additionally snapshots cleanup ownership before awaiting; exact-final full gate is recorded separately.

limits: No claim that the original intermittent JSON failure cause was found or that a production runtime bug was fixed.
No higher test/request timeout, skip, production backoff change, live ledger change, epoch/charge/deadline reset, deployment, cloud call or root worktree edit.
Local PostgreSQL gates do not establish deployed Workflow, Modal or provider success.
